metadata.title: EF-REG-005 Connected Action Center approval completes before Data Fabric decision

payload.elementDescription: The medium-sized 'Approvals' navigation item in the LEFT sidebar under the MANAGER section, directly below 'New Expense' and above the FINANCE section; it is the connected approval queue route, not the current expense-detail status text.

payload.script: const body=(document.body.innerText||''); const all=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('body *')).map(el=>(el.innerText||'').trim()).filter(Boolean); const matches=all.filter(t=>/EFREG005-Approve/i.test(t)); const pager=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button,a,[role="button"]')).map(el=>({text:(el.innerText||el.textContent||'').trim(),aria:el.getAttribute('aria-label'),disabled:!!el.disabled})).filter(x=>/next|previous|page|more/i.test([x.text,x.aria].join(' '))); return {url:location.href,hasTarget:/EFREG005-Approve/i.test(body),matchCount:matches.length,queueCount:(body.match(/\d+ expenses waiting on/g)||[]).length,hasPager:pager.length>0,pager,pendingCardCount:Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('textarea')).length,allTextLength:body.length};
